buildCommand: set -eu; node scripts/check-living-life-premium.mjs; node scripts/check-restoration-nvidia-chat.mjs; node scripts/inject-restoration-nvidia-chat.mjs; mkdir -p packages/app/public/data; base64 -d .tmp/ledger/master.gz.b64 | gzip -dc > packages/app/public/data/7ya-master-public-system.json; base64 -d .tmp/ledger/audit.gz.b64 | gzip -dc > packages/app/public/data/7ya-public-web-audit.json; node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('packages/app/public/data/7ya-master-public-system.json','utf8'));const a=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('packages/app/public/data/7ya-public-web-audit.json','utf8'));const d=m.sources.map(x=>x.id).filter((x,i,v)=>v.indexOf(x)!==i);if(m.sources.length!==83||a.urls.length!==83||m.moments.length<7||m.open_verification.length!==8||m.resolutions_and_discoveries.length!==11||d.length){throw new Error('7YA static ledger validation failed')}console.log('7YA static ledger validated: 83/83 URLs, 7 moments, 8 pending, 11 resolutions/discoveries')"
